newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore schools see "eye-robics" improving sight.
newsitem.headline: Singapore schools see "eye-robics" improving sight.

text.p: Every morning before assembly, thousands of Singapore school children stand in neat rows in the playground rubbing and rolling their eyes to slow music.

Teachers say the daily "eye-robics" sessions, which have been introduced in many schools across the island over the last few months, help improve blood, relax the eye muscles and reduce eye strain. Some say it can improve eyesight.
"We make the whole school do it in the square every morning before flag-raising and then again in classroom at break," said Chen Shao Chern, the principal of Bukit Merah Primary school.
"The pupils say they feel good afterwards and moan if it is raining and we can't do it outside," he told Reuters on Wednesday.
